label: Latin accents poorly drawn
description: Height, weight, or position of accents (acute, grave, circumflex, umlaut, cedilla…) inconsistent with the rest of the typeface.

label: Vietnamese accents poorly drawn
description: Tone mark + modified vowel stacking handled poorly (e.g. ẩ, ộ, ẫ, ẳ): collisions, system height, stacking order.

label: Combining accent (comb) issues
action: Set up the combining accents (anchors, mark positioning)
description: Dynamic positioning of combining diacritics (mark positioning, anchors, GDEF) over a variety of base letters.

label: Poorly drawn outlines
description: Superfluous points, bad tangents, un-cleaned overlaps, missing extrema, wrong contour direction.

label: Poorly constructed Cyrillic letters
description: Forms traced from Latin without adapting to Cyrillic drawing conventions (e.g. italic а, д, л, я).

label: Eszett (ß / ẞ — germandbls) poorly drawn
description: Incorrect construction of lowercase ß or capital ẞ, shape confusion with β or ss.

label: Poorly constructed Greek letters
description: Forms traced from Latin without respecting Greek conventions (tonal/polytonic forms included).

label: Incorrect Arabic forms / joining
action: Fix the Arabic forms and joining
description: Joining issues between isolated/initial/medial/final forms, or poorly drawn diacritic dots.

label: Incomplete character set
action: Complete the character set (GF Latin Core at least)
description: Glyphs Google Fonts expects are missing: currency and math signs, soft hyphen, small caps announced but missing, characters needed by the languages the font claims.

label: Inconsistent sidebearings and kerning
action: Even out the spacing and kerning
description: Irregular spacing, missing or inconsistent kerning pairs, disrupted visual rhythm.

label: Wrong vertical metrics
action: Fix the vertical metrics (hhea, typo, win)
description: Ascender, descender and line gap values that clip accents or give different line spacing across platforms and styles.

label: Hinting / on-screen rendering issues
description: Poor rendering at small sizes on screen (Windows/ClearType in particular), missing or poor hinting.

label: Poorly configured variable axes
action: Fix the variable font setup (axes, STAT, instances)
description: STAT table, fvar, inconsistent named instances, interpolation that breaks between masters.

label: Incorrect metadata / naming
description: Poorly filled name table, broken style linking, missing license or version information.
